subject.title: Windows: multiple gateway-down failure modes (kill-and-rebind restart loop, config-edit no-relaunch, browser launch crash, blocking pricing fetches)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical Windows gateway-down umbrella while maintainers split separate fixes for lifecycle, invalid-config repair, browser isolation, pricing readiness, and Claude CLI shim behavior?
rationale: The report spans multiple compatibility-sensitive runtime and recovery boundaries, so the fix order and product recovery surface need human ownership before automation attempts a patch.

options.title: Keep umbrella and split lifecycle first
options.body: Use this issue as the incident tracker and prioritize the gateway lifecycle/recovery fixes with live Windows proof before the narrower sub-bugs.

options.title: Require live Windows proof first
options.body: Pause implementation until a maintainer or reporter captures process, listener, browser, and startup timing proof on Windows.

options.title: Create separate canonical subissues
options.body: Move each proven failure mode to its own canonical issue and keep this umbrella only as a cross-reference.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and split lifecycle first
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the incident tracker and prioritize the gateway lifecycle/recovery fixes with live Windows proof before the narrower sub-bugs.
